projects.title: Companion (Alpha Preview)
projects.creator: AbyssTail
projects.summary: Your avatar, a little care, a place on Home.
projects.description:
Alpha Preview: an early preview in OctoFox OS. Features, balance and performance are still being developed.

A gentle virtual pet in your Home widget slot. Feed and rest with your profile avatar, three scenes, achievement reactions and notification hints. Playtime fills while you play games. Requires updated OctoFox OS with installed Home widget support (ui.home.widget:1); updating this package alone does not update the shell. Handheld acceptance pending.
